subject: Mental Models
title: Ecosystems as Models
description: Learn Ecosystems as Models in one minute.

hook.text: Yellowstone reintroduced 14 wolves in 1995. The wolves changed the rivers.

buildup.text: Ecosystems show how interconnected parts create resilience.

discovery.text: This is a trophic cascade: predators change prey behavior, which changes vegetation.

climax.text: Map your ecosystem: who depends on whom, what flows between them, and what breaks if one node disappears.

punchline.text: Everything connects. Pull one thread, the whole web moves.

quiz.question: How did wolves change the rivers in Yellowstone?
options: They shifted elk behavior, which regrew forests that stabilized riverbanks
Wolves drink large amounts of water
